claims.content: To initiate an emergency or force tell alert on tracks by setting the appropriate EMG IND or FT IND in J3.2 Air Track, J3.3 Surface (Maritime) Track, J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track, or J3.5 Land (Ground) Point/Track messages.

scope_contract.goal_statement: To initiate an emergency or force tell alert on tracks by setting the appropriate EMG IND or FT IND in J3.2 Air Track, J3.3 Surface (Maritime) Track, J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track, or J3.5 Land (Ground) Point/Track messages.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: For a selected track or point, the System Operator sets the appropriate EMG IND or FT IND in the applicable J3 track or point message, initiating the emergency or force tell alert.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The System Operator has identified a track or point and the applicable J3 track or point message in which an emergency or force tell alert is to be initiated.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The appropriate EMG IND or FT IND is set in the applicable J3 track or point message, initiating the emergency or force tell alert.
in_scope_actions: Set the appropriate EMG IND or FT IND in the applicable J3 track or point message to initiate an emergency or force tell alert.
excluded_adjacent_actions: Reporting on an already-existing emergency point report.
Reporting an emergency condition through a separate reporting objective that does not set an EMG IND or FT IND in a J3 track or point message.

claims.content: System Operator

The System Operator has identified a track or point—specifically an Air Track, Surface (Maritime) Track, Subsurface (Maritime) Track, or Land (Ground) Point/Track—and the applicable J3.2, J3.3, J3.4, or J3.5 message in which to initiate the emergency or force tell alert.
The initiating JU possesses the R² role required to initiate an emergency or force tell alert on tracks.
If the alert to be initiated is an EMG IND emergency alert, the selected track or point is not a Reference Point, line, area, or Space/Ballistic Missile Track.

A JU with R² shall initiate an emergency or force tell alert on tracks by setting the appropriate EMG IND or FT IND in the J3.2 Air Track, J3.3 Surface (Maritime) Track, J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track, or J3.5 Land (Ground) Point/Track message.

missing_aspects: The cited source text explicitly requires a 'JU with R²' to perform this action; the claim's attribution to 'System Operator' is not supported by the provided evidence.

claims.content: The System Operator selects the appropriate EMG IND or FT IND for the identified track or point, according to whether an emergency alert or a force tell alert is to be initiated.

The System Operator sets the selected EMG IND or FT IND to 1 in the applicable J3 track or point message: J3.2 Air Track, J3.3 Surface (Maritime) Track, J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track, or J3.5 Land (Ground) Point/Track.
The J3 message with the set EMG IND or FT IND indicates the emergency or force tell condition, initiating the emergency or force tell alert.
The J3 message with the set indicator overrides all operator-controllable data filters.
Diverges from Step 1 when an emergency alert is to be initiated: the JU with R² selects the EMG IND for the identified track or point.
Diverges from Step 1 when a force tell alert is to be initiated: the JU with R² selects the FT IND for the identified track or point.
Diverges from Step 2 for an Air Track: the JU with R² sets the selected EMG IND or FT IND to 1 in the J3.2 Air Track message.
Diverges from Step 2 for a Surface (Maritime) Track: the JU with R² sets the selected EMG IND or FT IND to 1 in the J3.3 Surface (Maritime) Track message.
Diverges from Step 2 for a Subsurface (Maritime) Track: the JU with R² sets the selected EMG IND or FT IND to 1 in the J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track message.
Diverges from Step 2 for a Land (Ground) Point/Track: the JU with R² sets the selected EMG IND or FT IND to 1 in the J3.5 Land (Ground) Point/Track message.

Exception branch 1 — At main flow step 2, if the System Operator attempts to set an EMG IND to 1 on a Reference Point or a Space/Ballistic Missile Track, the emergency alert shall not be initiated. Exit: no emergency alert is initiated on that target.

Exception branch 2 — At main flow step 2, if the System Operator attempts to set an EMG IND or FT IND on a track or point that is ineligible for such an alert (for example, an illegal change marked 'X', or a change from SPACE TRK to AIR TRK marked 'S' that requires operator alert), the system shall reject the data as invalid per paragraph 4.7.1.2.1. Exit: the data is rejected as invalid.

Exception branch 3 — At main flow step 2, if the System Operator is a JU without R², the JU shall initiate the emergency or force tell alert by setting the appropriate EMG IND or FT IND in a J7.0 (ACT = 3 or 4) message. Exit: the alert initiation is performed through the J7.0 (ACT = 3 or 4) message.

Exception branch 4 — At main flow step 2, if the System Operator attempts to use the J3.1 Emergency Point message, alerts are not used for that message because J3.1 Emergency Points cannot be filtered. Exit: no alert is set in the J3.1 Emergency Point message.

missing_aspects: Documented system response or recovery after selecting a prohibited target for an EMG IND is not specified.
Whether the J7.0 no-R² initiation path is within this use case or handled as an adjacent use case, and the explicit exit or continuation after that handoff, is not specified.
Explicit exit or continuation criteria after the J7.0 (ACT = 3 or 4) message transmission are not specified.
Applicability of the no-R² J7.0 initiation path to subsurface contacts is not clearly specified.

claims.content: The applicable J3.2 Air Track, J3.3 Surface (Maritime) Track, J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track, or J3.5 Land (Ground) Point/Track message contains the selected EMG IND or FT IND set to 1.
The track or point with EMG IND or FT IND set to 1 is not filtered; the indicator overrides all operator-controllable filters, including security filters.
All receiving JUs accept the alert in their databases upon receipt of the J3 message with EMG IND or FT IND set to 1.

The alert remains active in receiving JUs' databases until it is terminated by receipt of a J7.0 (ACT = 3 or 4) message or optionally cleared by reception of a J3.X message with EMG IND and/or FT IND set to 0.
